paragraphs: From Thurles test centre, depart right onto the R659 and continue for about 300 metres
At the end of the road turn left to stay on the R659

Take your next left onto Inisfallen Avenue continue straight ahead as the road becomes Iona Avenue and then Butler Avenue, watching your speed and observing for parked cars in this residential stretch
Turn left onto Matthew Avenue and follow it for roughly half a kilometre
At the roundabout take the exit on the right into Kennedy Park, which leads you into Collins Park
Drive on through Collins Park and continue straight as the road becomes Childers Park
Take the next right within Childers Park, then a quick left onto Thurles Urban, followed by a right back into Childers Park for a short loop
Come back out with a left left again onto Thurles Urban, and at the end of the road turn right onto Childers Park
Turn left onto the L4027 and follow it take another left to stay on the L4027
At the mini roundabout, go straight ahead onto Jimmy Doyle Road
Exit the next rotary by bearing left to stay on Jimmy Doyle Road
Turn left and continue for over a kilometre until you arrive on the L4039
From here, depart to the left on the L4039 take a right onto an unnamed local road
Continue on this rural section, taking a further right and then another right to complete the country roads segment
Head back into town and turn left onto Liberty Square
1st right onto Slievenamon Road take the next right onto Fianna Road
Right again onto an unnamed road continue on and at the end of the road turn left
Left again onto Croke Street at the end of Croke Street turn right onto West Gate
Left onto Liberty Square continue straight onto Parnell Street for around 700 metres, then straight again as it becomes an unnamed road leading to the rotary
Go straight through the rotary onto Jimmy Doyle Road and exit left to stay on it
Take the next left, then a quick right, and follow the road back toward the Thurles test centre to finish the route
